name: investment.compound_ledger

list.description: Query native investment records in the declared scope.

get.description: Read one native root detail online without changing a saved List.

lookup.name: compoundOrderNo
lookup.description: Native lookup sent as compoundOrderNo; use the unprojected List orderNo value.

result_identity.description: Native detail orderNo; exact nonempty string echo of the requested lookup.

purpose: Inspect native investment business records through inquiry-only endpoints.
limitations: JSON POST /compoundOrderList.json; fixed tenant GUAPW3SG; rowStart offsets of width 5000; data.data and fixed data.totalCount.
Native fields, amounts, rates, nulls, unknown fields and response order are retained without conversion.

The host List SDK deduplicates native identities and uses the last arrival for conflicting records; conflicts or count gaps remain incomplete. Only complete nonempty refresh publishes; empty, failed or incomplete refresh preserves the previous snapshot. Live never publishes.
Installation initializes an empty binding only; explicit sync uses the declared acquisition and publication policy.
Native Get uses POST form /compoundOrderDetail.json; lookup compoundOrderNo returns one native root object with orderNo.
Get preserves all native nested fields and unknown values; separately queried history, logs and child endpoints remain unqueried.
Get is live-only and publishes no cache or Duckdog data.

List --live --with-detail fetches native Detail only for the selected offset/limit window, returns separate record/detail members and fails atomically on any detail error; saved List data remains unchanged.

examples.title: Read one selected List row with its native detail

sync.evidence: Native record identity: orderNo. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
